entry.name: Necrozma Ultra
entry.flavorEs: Con sus rayos láser destruye todo a su paso en busca de luz para sustentarse.
entry.flavorZh: 为生存而发狂般地寻找着光。 会发射出激光， 将所有东西切成碎片。

abilities.textEn: This Pokemon's attacks that are super effective against the target do 1.25x damage.
abilities.detail: This Pokemon's attacks that are super effective against the target have their damage multiplied by 1.25.
abilities.detailEs: Aumenta el daño supereficaz infligido a 1.25×.
abilities.detailZh: 使造成的效果绝佳伤害提升至1.25×。
abilities.detailPt: Aumenta o dano supereficaz causado para 1.25×.

hiddenpower.descEs: Este movimiento tiene un tipo variable y un poder base variable entre 30 y 70, dependiendo de los IV′s del usuario.
hiddenpower.descZh: 招式的属性会随着使用此招式的宝可梦而改变。
